## Outcome

A fresh core01 Open Brain backup can be transferred encrypted, verified, restored into an isolated local PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector database, and served only on loopback with local embeddings and local-only credentials.

## Acceptance

- backup manifest facts and pg_dump share one PostgreSQL snapshot
- local-clone mode validates configuration before pool creation or migrations
- Open Brain binds to literal loopback and cannot inherit production DB/provider/NATS/watchdog/QMD/WAL paths
- restore uses a fresh explicit database and existing verification substrate; no wipe-in-place refresh
- local embedding provider matches the stored 768-dimension embedding contract
- functional real-PostgreSQL concurrency, restore, health, read/write, isolation, restart, and socket tests pass
- core01 receives no validation writes and remains healthy
- content-free receipts and errors are preserved
